outcome: Persistent core separation is verified at multiple UE counts, but is not a complete scaling remedy. Four-UE ON held real-time cadence in this run; eight-UE ON remained below real time; sixteen-UE runs showed protocol-health failures.

configuration.ue: CPU srsUE with existing local pilot-noise repair
configuration.io_policy: Existing IO/RF RX FIFO95 applied to every UE in both comparison modes

known_wait_findings: No millisecond-scale yields were recorded at the two previously identified gNB CUDA-wait call sites in the completed 8/16-UE trials; the largest tracked 16-UE interval was 135.535 us OFF and 119.917 us ON. This does not localize every remaining wait or GPU operation.

native_failure.operation: CPU srsUE RLC AM NR retransmission segment calculation
native_failure.effect: UE process aborted; missing IQ then stalled the common-input broker, which triggered its 10 s wedge detector.
native_failure.comparison: Excluded from completed-run speed comparison. Repeat ON completed with post-warmup ratio 0.442997, but all 16 UEs showed repeated SR exhaustion during the execution.

lifecycle_interpretation: The console-derived rrc_release counter counts Scheduling request failed: releasing RRC connection messages. Source calls the empty NR release_pucch_srs hook, clears pending PHY grants and starts MAC random access; it is not itself proof of an RRC state transition.
limits: One cold trial per ordinary configuration, with a repeated 16-UE ON trial after the first aborted. Small speed differences are observations, not a repeatability claim.
The one-UE trial retained one 1.022 ms endpoint lag; not all runs are strictly zero-miss.
UE counts 5-7 and counts above16 were not tested. No universal maximum UE count is established.
KPI-valid window counts and startup attachment gates do not establish uninterrupted protocol health.

instrumentation.change: Only broker capture capacity enlarged 1.5M to 6M records; source equivalence asserted

cleanup: All owned benchmark/observer/reservation processes stopped and temporary memory captures archived on Spark. Persistent deployment remains enabled by default; original binaries and frozen inputs are unchanged; HTML unchanged.
